steps.content: As the battle subsided, twisted shapes of crimson light rose from the humanoid mass, coalescing into the form of a flower.

steps.speaker: Dravyn
steps.content: ...That's it!
He moved forward to examine it, but a frail voice pulled at his attention.

steps.speaker: Parma
steps.content: ...So close... just a little more... Don't touch him... You mustn't...

steps.speaker: Parma
steps.content: You're not qualified... You can't take it... You'll die too... Listen, let's make a deal.

steps.speaker: Parma
steps.content: There's a war happening on the surface, isn't there? We can give you power, or help you kill your enemies. Anything you want. Just don't interrupt the ritual. I'll do anything...

steps.speaker: Parma
steps.content: The Sage must be born... We've come this far... Don't harm him...

steps.speaker: Dravyn
steps.content: Sage... What is that?

steps.speaker: Dravyn
steps.content: No. It doesn't matter...

steps.speaker: Dravyn
steps.content: If it serves my goal... if it leads to victory, I'll use any power. Whatever it takes.

steps.speaker: Dravyn
steps.content: If even my life can be spent in service of this cause... then that is the utmost glory!
He reached for the crystal flower, and pain tore through him. It was a silent explosion from his very core, a wave of invisible spikes shredding his nerves.

steps.speaker: Vennon
steps.content: Major!!

steps.speaker: Parma
steps.content: Stop! Ahhhhhhhh!!!
Dravyn instinctively clenched his fist, driving the sharp petals deeper into his palm. Blood, hot and slick, welled between his fingers as silent screams echoed in his skull.

<size=56><color=#dg1f1f>Surrender, just surrender</color>! <size=40>There's still a chance for us.　　<size=40>

　　　　　Stop <size=50>holding on stubbornly. This <size=36>isn't good for anyone. <size=50><color=#dg1f1f>Negotiate with them. There's a real chance it could work.</color></size>

Brock died <size=56><color=#dg1f1f>for nothing</color>! <size=40>The Independence Army can <size=50><color=#dg1f1f>never win!</color></size>

　　Why are you still hunting <size=50><color=#dg1f1f>spies</color></size>? <size=40>They are</size> <size=50><color=#dg1f1f>all around</color></size> you. <size=56><color=#dg1f1f>You can't win this!</color></size>

steps.speaker: Brock
steps.content: DisCity... It's... in your hands now...

steps.speaker: Catherine
steps.content: As the new commander of the DisCity Independence Army, can you accept that?
—If conviction doesn't win the war, what's the value of the battle? What's the point of the sacrifice?
Chaotic memories shattered through his mind, page by page, each one stained red and piercing his heart. The unbearable pain seized him, dragging him into the abyss.
Gritting his teeth, he clenched the petals with desperate strength, as if by sheer will he could wrest victory from the jaws of darkness.
<size=50>Yes, I will win! I will make it matter!</size>

Then, the red crystal flower began to dissolve, seeping into his skin. A sublime and profound power merged with his body and mind, flooding him with a long-forgotten peace as he sank into the waiting dark.
[Scene Change] Camp Infirmary (or a run-down hospital ward)
Upon waking, Dravyn found himself back at the camp. He was still alive. He carefully checked his own body, but the flower was gone. Then he saw it.

steps.speaker: Dravyn
steps.content: Vennon!

There lay Vennon on the adjacent bed, barely clinging to life. The malevolent blossom had taken root in the center of his throat. When Vennon tried to speak, only a hoarse, broken rasp escaped his lips.

steps.speaker: Vennon
steps.content: I was a spy planted by the DisCity military. My mission was to monitor you and Brock, find anything we could use against you.

steps.speaker: Vennon
steps.content: I intercepted your communications with EDGE, too. But after following you both... learning the truth... I defected. This is a spy's surrender. Will you accept it?

steps.speaker: Dravyn
steps.content: ...You fool. Then you should've known this would kill you!

steps.speaker: Vennon
steps.content: I know. I'm the fourth carrier. If I die, another will take my place... It is... an extraordinary power.
With the help of the EDGE intern, they expended tremendous effort to identify another suitable host and transfer the flower from the dying Dravyn.

steps.speaker: Vennon
steps.content: Following your orders... we secured it. A weapon that can turn the tide.
A violent, wracking cough seized Vennon, tearing from his chest and leaving him gasping for long, desperate moments before he could reclaim his breath.

steps.speaker: Vennon
steps.content: Martin, Tom, Joe... We all knew the risks. It's just one life. Dying on the battlefield or here... it's all the same. That's what it means to be a DisCity soldier.

steps.speaker: Vennon
steps.content: We're marching into the worst kind of war, the kind fought in human weakness, madness, and ignorance. One misstep... one moment of doubt... could be catastrophic.

steps.speaker: Vennon
steps.content: So we cut away weakness. Follow orders. No hesitation. No second guesses. We advance. Unwaveringly.

steps.speaker: Vennon
steps.content: Because we believe in you. We trust you'll lead us right.

steps.speaker: Vennon
steps.content: Back then, you told Brock he had to survive, no matter what. Now... I want you to remember those words.

steps.speaker: Vennon
steps.content: We're the DisCity Independence Army now. We need you. You are not allowed to die.
Vennon struggled to sit upright, attempting to move closer to Dravyn. The searing, needle-like pain in his chest momentarily sharpened his focus.

steps.speaker: Vennon
steps.content: Live. Wield the weapon we secured. Use it to bring victory. That's your duty, Commander.

steps.speaker: Dravyn
steps.content: ...Fool.

steps.speaker: Dravyn
steps.content: As my subordinate, you failed to follow a direct order. I won't tolerate insubordination. Your punishment: 100 weighted squats and 50 klicks in full gear.

steps.speaker: Dravyn
steps.content: After we win the battle and return to the city, you will complete every last one. Is that clear?!

steps.speaker: Vennon
steps.content: Yes, Major.
After Vennon's departure, Dravyn turned his attention to the documents, examining the letter from the EDGE intern.
There was one last thing to address, the most crucial matter...
[Transition] Small CG: Catherine at the gravesite

steps.speaker: Catherine
steps.content: You've kept a lady waiting far too long. I was starting to think you were dead.

steps.speaker: Catherine
steps.content: Well? Did you succeed?
[Fade to white] Return to present day
[Scene Change] Nirvana Port
Night has engulfed Nirvana Port. Scarface is splayed awkwardly across his bunk, mumbling into a crumpled pillow.

steps.speaker: Scarface
steps.content: BANG! Ha! Ain't I awesome? When you go out there... stand tall and proud!

steps.speaker: Scarface
steps.content: I'm a hero who defends... our city... a great hero who... protects Lily...

steps.speaker: Scarface
steps.content: Home... after I win this... I'll go home...

With a thunderous roar, the magnetic engines of Nirvana Port surge to life. The colossal fortress shudders, delivering Augustus's command across the port. Its course is set for the farlands, its purpose clear for war.
It is also a command from their long-missed homeland:
Reach the farlands. Eliminate all opposition.

steps.speaker: Lieutenant
steps.content: ...If that's your assessment, if it serves the city, then I'll see it done.

steps.speaker: Lieutenant
steps.content: We've done far worse. We hid behind glory, behind loyalty... and finally, behind obedience. Since we lacked the will to refuse back then, everything that comes now is a fate of our own making.

steps.speaker: Lieutenant
steps.content: I don't have the right to repent. My remorse changes nothing. Compensates no one. Not even death can absolve what I've done. Hellhounds would never dream of forgiveness.

steps.speaker: Lieutenant
steps.content: The Rancors know no emotions. We're your weapons, tools to turn the battle. Your only concern is victory.

steps.speaker: Lieutenant
steps.content: We will secure that victory for you. And then we'll reshape the world that made us. That is our final purpose. Nothing beyond that needs to concern you.

steps.speaker: Lieutenant
steps.content: We've long since fallen among the damned. And the damned have no right to speak of souls.
After the lieutenant's report, Augustus falls silent. The hushed whispers of Nirvana Port's Rancors echo by her ear, but she only listens, not uttering a word.
...Fraser's Hypercube stockpile exceeds that of all the farlands combined. Their true face has never changed. Power! All they seek is military power to dominate us all!

What they truly covet are DisCity's mines. Even if they seize control of DisCity again, the weak farlands will gain nothing. They incite hatred among the farlands to overthrow DisCity, and it would only return us to the past, when all city-states were enslaved by the metropoles.

Protecting DisCity from these sinister ambitions... this has been our purpose since the bygone era... We hunger for bloodshed, and only through it can this unjust world be saved. This has always been the way—
Now, prepare to embrace death and glory!

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: ...Talk about swords dug from tombs. The weight of that is staggering.
Just then, footsteps approach, followed by a sharp knock at the door. The Rancors fall instantly silent.
Augustus looks up, her eyes shifting toward the sound.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: ...You've come...
